spec.scene: A small rocky hilltop patch of dry grass and stone, one tall crooked grey metal pole standing at its center. Below and around it the slope falls away, dotted with a few brown-and-white cows grazing. A dad in a green cap stands beside the pole, one small figure with arms up. At the back edge sits a fragment of a diner booth with glossy red seats, a plate of pancakes and a basket of red tomatoes. Warm orange sunset light glows on the stone and shines along the pole.
spec.title: The Pole at Sunrise
spec.caption: We made it to the top by sunrise, five stops and all. Good morning, Dad.
